text:
sam: FYI running a preflight for the onprem-eu cluster before we push the RBAC + netpol lockdown. Want to run through the checklist here.
nina: please include step to verify audit-forwarder egress and that kubelet can reach vault-unseal; last time migration failed because of egress rules.
sam: agreed. current plan: 1) canary netpol to one node 2) apply RBAC policy requiring MFA for breakglass 3) run migration job 4) validate audits shipped for 15m then roll cluster-wide.
arthur: add: a migration heartbeat that asserts `vault-unseal:connected` across all nodes before allowing rolling restarts. If heartbeat fails, abort.
nina: netpol canary snippet I'm testing:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: canary-audit-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: audit-forwarder
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 10.10.200.0/24
          ports:
            - protocol: TCP
              port: 443
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
```
sam: will apply to node eu-canary-01 only via nodeSelector; after 5m we check `audit_forwarder_queue_bytes` and `vault_audit_lines` count.
audit-bot: baseline metrics: audit_forwarder_queue_bytes=0, vault_audit_lines(last5m)=120. Will track for canary.
arthur: RBAC policy we'll push to vault for keystore-breakglass:
```
path "transit/*" {
  capabilities = ["wrap","read"]
  allowed_params = { "auth_method" = ["mfa"], "source_ip" = ["10.10.200.0/24"] }
}
```
sam: important: ensure service accounts used by CI do not get breakglass tokens; rotate any long-lived tokens before migration.
nina: preflight command list:
- `kubectl -n priv-keystore get pods -o wide | grep audit-forwarder`
- `curl -sS http://10.10.200.5:8200/v1/sys/health` (expect unsealed)
- `kubectl -n priv-keystore logs audit-forwarder --tail=100 | grep -i ship`
sam: runbook on failure: if `vault-unseal` health != sealed/unsealed -> abort migration and open incident. If audit_forwarder_queue_bytes > 50MB after 10m, revert netpol and escalate.
arthur: I'll add a CI gate so automated rolling restarts check the heartbeat; will also add `migration_applied` metric emitted by the migration job.
nina: running canary apply now to eu-canary-01. Will report back with metrics in 10m.
audit-bot: canary applied. starting 15m timer and metric watch.
sam: thanks. If this stabilizes, we will schedule the full rollout with a 30m pause between nodes and a dedicated oncall to watch audit retention.
nina: can confirm audit lines flowing after 6m; `vault_audit_lines` increased and `audit_forwarder_queue_bytes` stayed <5MB.
sam: good signal. I'll trigger staged rollout with canary window. Keep thread for notes and any aborted rollbacks.
